outcome: refusal of feed with respiratory distress
cohort: 58 term neonates from birth to the 28th day of life, including 28 neonates with suspected sepsis (23 with culture-proven and 5 with clinical sepsis) and 26 healthy controls.
finding: Salivary CRP is a reliable indicator for quickly diagnosing sepsis.
mod_finding: Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS) was the mode of delivery used in a higher percentage of patients (54%) compared to vaginal delivery (46%).
gest_age: Term neonates, with a significant difference between groups (p=0.042)
birth_weight: No significant difference in birth weight between groups
